_comment: AD-131: the forester's hut I..VI. radius: blocks from the hut door he fells wild trees in; rise: how far above or below the door a tree may stand (the reach is a cylinder, not a column of the whole world); scan_columns: columns of the search spiral a call; leaves_min: natural (non-persistent) leaves round a tree's logs that make it wild; max_logs: a tree of more logs is left whole; crown_leaves_max: leaves felled with a tree; trees_per_trip/walk_speed by level; next_tree_reach: how far from the last foot a trip's next tree may stand; bare_feet_max: bare feet the hut remembers; sapling_stock: saplings of each opened kind the hut asks for at III+; saw: the sawmill (IV+) turns one log into planks_per_log planks every period ticks while the hut keeps more than log_keep logs and the hall fewer than plank_target planks; grove (VI): six courtyard cells, a sapling grows into a compact tree after grow_ticks, the saw fells saw_ticks_per_log a log, the grove takes a turn every turn ticks.
